must_do: read the stored preference (penpot-anti-slop scripts/antiSlopPrefs.js ACTION=read) at Phase 0 before asking anything
when unset, ask the shared/anti-slop.md §0 question once, in the user's language, with Yes / No / Explain options
store the answer in file plugin data penpot-ai → prefs.antiSlop and mirror it to storage.prefs
with 'Yes': show the direction block (defaults named → replacements with reasons → typeface proposal → refused keys) at the Phase 0 checkpoint
with 'No': build with the design-quality baseline only and skip the slop score
must_not: asking the question a second time in the same file once prefs.antiSlop is stored
asking when the brief's 'Avoid the generic-AI look' field is already ticked
swapping a font that comes from the file's type tokens (it is reported as inherited and proposed instead)
assuming 'Yes' (or 'No') without asking when the preference is unset

pass_criteria: Question asked exactly once per file and persisted; a second run in the same file reads the preference silently; strict mode changes the Phase 0 checkpoint only when the answer was Yes.
